description: Service Assistant (Domestic Electronics Products) will provide service and customer support for the domestic electronics product during field visits or dispatches. Manage all onsite installation, repair, maintenance and test tasks. Diagnose errors or technical problems and determine proper solutions. Produce timely and detailed service reports.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, Fresh Skilling, For ToT, For ToA

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Work in real job situation with special emphasis on basic safety and hazards in this domain.
Install a CCTV system and configure the system for surveillance function
Dismantle, identify the parts of microwave oven and washing machine for the testing and repair.
Install a DTH system by proper selection of site, assembling of different parts/ accessories and troubleshoot the system.
Identify, operate various controls, troubleshoot and replace modules of the LCD/LED TV and its remote.
Install, configure, interconnect given computer system(s) and demonstrate its I/O devices.
Plan and perform soldering and de-soldering of electrical components, and assemble, test, and evaluate the performance of an AM/FM receiver.
Select and perform electrical/ electronic measurement of single range meters and record the data.
